sloka: न हि शक्तः स दुष्टात्मा मनसा ऽपि हि मैथिलीम् ।प्रधर्षयितुमप्राप्तां दीप्तामग्निशिखामिव ।। ६.१२१.१९ ।।
transliteration: na hi śaktaḥ sa duṣṭātmā manasā 'pi hi maithilīm ।pradharṣayitumaprāptāṁ dīptāmagniśikhāmiva ।। 6.121.19 ।।

translations.english: " Auspicious Sita would not have cared for the fortunes in the gynaeceum of Ravana. She is just like the radiance of the sun attached to the sun, attached to me and none other."
